posts.name: Akshobh Verma
posts.cooked: Can we use the /opt/se2001/ folder to directly run our script on public test cases during OPPE?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Yes you can do it for testing if your script is working but you have to do sychro eval for submitting. You have to write script in ~/se2001/ directory.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You can directly view test cases using

alias ptc='find /opt/se2001/$(basename $PWD)/ -type f -name "*put.txt" | grep public|sort | while read -r filename; do batcat "$filename"; done'

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: @21f3000759 can you update this with the function.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
ptc() {
    find /opt/se2001/"$(basename "$PWD")"/ -type f -name "*put.txt" \
    | grep public \
    | sort \
    | while read -r filename; do
        batcat "$filename"
    done
}
